newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile Feb mining output off slightly on 1996.
newsitem.headline: Chile Feb mining output off slightly on 1996.

text.p: Chilean mining production fell 0.6 percent in February compared with the same month last year, said the National Statistics Institute.
The figures showed mining output rising 6.4 percent in the first two months of the year against the same period 1996.
The main reason for February's drop was a 0.9 percent reduction in metallic mining output, said the report. Non- metallic mining production was up five percent on February 1996.
Copper production fell 0.2 percent with lead off 32.6 percent, gold down 12.8 percent and iron outout dropping 5.2 percent on February 1996.
Rises in production were seen in molybdenum, up 17.7 percent and zinc which rose 7.8 percent on the same month last year.
